user.title: Set up Smart Car Charger
user.description: Pick the entities that control/report your vehicle's charging.

data.energy_added_sensor_entity: Energy added sensor (optional, enables self-calibrating capacity)
data.location_tracker_entity: Vehicle location tracker (optional, together with the zone below only charges while home)
data.home_zone_entity: Zone the vehicle must be in to charge (optional, requires the tracker above)
data.charge_power_kw: Assumed charging power (kW) - starting value, self-calibrated once a power sensor is set
data.charge_power_sensor_entity: Live charging power sensor (optional, enables self-calibration)
data.car_charge_limit_entity: Car charge-limit entity (optional, number) — while power is cheap vs. the last 8 days, top up opportunistically toward this SoC beyond the cycle target
data.pause_mode_sensor_entity: Pause-Mode sensor (optional) — while its state equals the value below, the scheduler leaves the charge switch alone (e.g. wallbox working mode handled by PV-surplus control)
data.pause_mode_value: Pause value (state of the sensor above that pauses the scheduler)
data.tibber_home_nickname: Tibber home nickname (as shown in the Tibber app)
data.battery_capacity_kwh_default: Battery capacity (kWh) — starting estimate, refined automatically over time
data.tankerkoenig_api_key: Tankerkönig API key (optional) — enables the fuel-price and combustion break-even sensors
data.fuel_radius_km: Search radius for fuel stations (km, around your Home Assistant location)
data.odometer_entity: Odometer sensor (optional, km) — with the charge-energy sensor below, self-calibrates the EV's kWh/100 km from the socket
data.charge_energy_entity: Cumulative charge-energy sensor (optional, kWh from the wallbox/socket)
data.current_price_sensor_entity: Live electricity-price sensor (optional, €/kWh) — only used for the 'cheaper right now' comparison when no charge plan is active
data.charge_current_entity: Charging-current entity (optional, number, A) — setpoint for “Überschuss Smart” (e.g. the Tesla charging-current number)
data.pv_power_sensor_entity: PV power sensor (optional, kW) — for “Überschuss Smart”
data.house_load_sensor_entity: House consumption sensor incl. wallbox (optional, kW) — for “Überschuss Smart”
data.home_battery_soc_sensor_entity: Home-battery state of charge (optional, %) — for “Überschuss Smart”
data.car_charge_limit_fallback_sensor_entity: Fallback charge-limit sensor (optional) — read when the car charge-limit entity above is unknown (e.g. the TeslaMate charge limit)
